inputs.seed_note: no random numbers are drawn in P8

evidence_class: A requirement, not a verification (spec P8).

choices.why: Spec P8 and rulings B-4 and B-9d: R18 holds only if the autopilot keeps the aircraft at or below V_C in level flight at every altitude, and a gust criterion above V_C is set. P8 writes that requirement with one table, EP-1 to EP-9, each row with a number and the record it comes from. It is a requirement on a system this repository does not design (PD-11): no control law, no simulation, no dynamic stability, no lateral-directional analysis.

ep2_power_limit.rule: At each altitude and flown weight, the shaft power for level flight at V_C: drag of r0's polar (CD0 build-up at the speed, K of the record) times the true speed, over r0's App. L propeller efficiency (owner ruling G-4), as Stage 1's own level-speed code does it. The engine's full-throttle shaft power at that speed and altitude is P0's table (r0/m250_table.json) through r0's engine model. Excess = full-throttle power less the limit. Where the full-throttle power is below the limit, level flight does not reach V_C and no limit is needed there.
ep2_power_limit.every_weight: judgement: the limit that holds at every flown weight is the smallest of the per-weight limits (the lightest weight needs the least power at V_C)
ep2_power_limit.coding_check: the shaft power for level flight at r0's recorded level top speed (sea level and 20,000 ft, take-off weight) equals the full-throttle power within the tolerance

p6_second_reading.rule: P6's representative blade (its blade ledger, twist and sections as prelim/p6_propeller.aircraft sets them), constant speed: the shaft power whose thrust equals the drag at V_C, by fixed-point iteration hp = D V/(550 eta_P6(hp)) from the App. L limit. P6 failed its validation (row 5) and its numbers are not used in r1: this is a labelled second reading with no weight in the requirement.

ep3_overspeed.limits_source: P5 row 3 limits (p5.json row3.limits): +3.8 and the gust limit -1.7

readings.ruled_rule: The spec's reading: the gust speed of the ruled rule at the speed (30 ft/s at V_C falling linearly to 15 ft/s at V_D, Raymer p. 339, PD-8). The largest speed not above V_D at which the gust load factor stays inside the limits.
readings.held_at_vc_gust: judgement (PD-24 item 1): the gust held at the V_C value, 30 ft/s, at the excursion speed. A gust met while the aircraft overspeeds in level flight is the gust of level flight, not of a dive. This is P5 row 4's "gust held at 30 ft/s above V_C".

ep3_overspeed.stated_why: Under the ruled rule the product of gust speed and speed, U V, is stationary at V_C and falls above it; only the lift slope's rise with Mach number lifts the gust load factor, slightly, above its V_C value. So the spec's reading may bound nothing below V_D; the record shows whether it does. The requirement takes the held reading, and reports the spec's reading beside it.

ep4_dive.idle_rule: judgement: idle is zero propeller thrust (no windmilling drag and no residual thrust are credited)
ep4_dive.full_rule: full-throttle shaft power of P0's table through r0's engine model, thrust by r0's App. L propeller at the speed
ep4_dive.path: Point mass on a straight path at a constant descent angle gamma, entered at V_C at the start altitude (no pushover): (W/g) dV/dt = T - D + W sin(gamma), dh/dt = -V sin(gamma), lift W cos(gamma), drag of r0's polar at the speed and altitude. Stops at V_D (EAS), at sea level, or at the time limit.
ep4_dive.solver: scipy.integrate.solve_ivp, method DOP853, rtol 1e-9, atol 1e-9, max_step 1 s; the stops are events

ep5_load_factor.command_margin_source: judgement (PD-24 item 2): the ledger's margin_gust_g (0.1 g) on both sides of the R9 limits
ep5_load_factor.r16: ledger turn_bank_deg: n = 1/cos(bank); available if inside the positive command limit and below the stall-limited load factor at the loiter speed, 20,000 ft and the loiter start weight

ep6_low_speed.rule: 1.3 V_stall clean (ledger speed_over_stall, R17) at the current weight, V_stall = sqrt(2 W/(rho_0 S CL_max)) in EAS
ep6_low_speed.cl_max: r0's 1.35 (design_pusher.json CL_max.clean) and P2's measured 1.276 (p2.json wing.measured.clean), the r1 value

ep8_altitude.protection_altitude_limit: judgement (PD-24 item 3): the protection holds the aircraft at or below R12's 23,000 ft (ledger ceiling_ft). It is the highest altitude any requirement needs, so the highest at which R-f's declared engine assumptions are used. The service ceiling of r0 is above it.

p6_second_reading.label: second reading, no weight: P6 failed its validation (row 5) and its numbers are not used in r1

rows.title: Speed hold
rows.text: The protection holds the speed at or below V_C = {V_C} kt EAS at every altitude and every weight, in climb, level flight and descent (R18). V_D = {V_D} kt EAS. The fastest mission sub-step is {fastest} kt EAS, below V_C.
rows.headline: V_C
rows.statement: The protection holds the speed at or below V_C = 110.0 kt EAS at every altitude and every weight, in climb, level flight and descent (R18). V_D = 165.0 kt EAS. The fastest mission sub-step is 94.96 kt EAS, below V_C.

rows.title: Power limit schedule
rows.text: In level flight the shaft power is limited to the power that holds V_C: {lim_sl} hp at sea level, {lim_20} hp at 20,000 ft and {lim_23} hp at 23,000 ft (lightest flown weight; schedule S-2). The engine's excess above the limit is {exc_sl} hp at sea level and {exc_20} hp at 20,000 ft. Above {cross_lo} ft ({cross_lo_w}) to {cross_hi} ft ({cross_hi_w}) full throttle does not reach V_C and no limit is needed. Without the limit the level top speed is {vmax_sl} kt EAS at sea level and {vmax_20} kt EAS at 20,000 ft. Second reading, no weight (P6 failed its validation): P6's blade needs {p6_sl} hp at sea level.
rows.headline: lim_sl
rows.statement: In level flight the shaft power is limited to the power that holds V_C: 104.7 hp at sea level, 153.0 hp at 20,000 ft and 162.7 hp at 23,000 ft (lightest flown weight; schedule S-2). The engine's excess above the limit is 345.3 hp at sea level and 54.6 hp at 20,000 ft. Above 23,183 ft (take-off weight) to 24,846 ft (payload off with ballast) full throttle does not reach V_C and no limit is needed. Without the limit the level top speed is 185.2 kt EAS at sea level and 120.9 kt EAS at 20,000 ft. Second reading, no weight (P6 failed its validation): P6's blade needs 112.6 hp at sea level.

rows.title: Overspeed margin
rows.text: The protection may let the speed exceed V_C by at most {exc} kt EAS at and below {alt} ft (computed {exc_full} kt, rounded down; {exc_20} kt at 20,000 ft, {exc_sl} kt at sea level; schedule S-3), so that a {U} ft/s gust met at that speed stays inside +{npos} and {nneg} (PD-24 item 1). With the ruled rule's own gust speed at the speed (the spec's reading) nothing binds up to V_D at and below {alt} ft: the smallest excursion is {ruled} kt, against V_D - V_C = {vdvc} kt.
rows.headline: exc
rows.statement: The protection may let the speed exceed V_C by at most 3.9 kt EAS at and below 23,000 ft (computed 3.987 kt, rounded down; 7.4 kt at 20,000 ft, 37.5 kt at sea level; schedule S-3), so that a 30 ft/s gust met at that speed stays inside +3.8 and -1.7 (PD-24 item 1). With the ruled rule's own gust speed at the speed (the spec's reading) nothing binds up to V_D at and below 23,000 ft: the smallest excursion is 55.0 kt, against V_D - V_C = 55.0 kt.

rows.title: Dive margin
rows.text: If the speed hold fails, a dive entered at V_C reaches V_D in as little as {t_min} s (45 deg path: {t_full45} s at full power, {t_idle45} s at idle; schedule S-4), and the least height lost on the way is {h_min} ft. At idle on a 5 deg path V_D is reached in {idle5} of {idle5_n} cases. The protection must stop the acceleration within that time.
rows.headline: t_min
rows.statement: If the speed hold fails, a dive entered at V_C reaches V_D in as little as 4.2 s (45 deg path: 4.2 s at full power, 5.4 s at idle; schedule S-4), and the least height lost on the way is 583 ft. At idle on a 5 deg path V_D is reached in 0 of 6 cases. The protection must stop the acceleration within that time.

rows.title: Load-factor command limits
rows.text: Commanded load factor between {neg_cmd} and +{pos_cmd}: the R9 limits +{pos} and {neg} less the record's {m} g margin (PD-24 item 2). The R16 turn, n = {n16}, stays available: the stall allows {stall_r0} at the loiter speed and 20,000 ft ({stall_r1} with P2's C_L,max). The negative limit is reachable below V_C (negative corner {negc} kt EAS at take-off weight), so the protection must hold it.
rows.headline: pos_cmd
rows.statement: Commanded load factor between -1.7 and +3.7: the R9 limits +3.8 and -1.8 less the record's 0.1 g margin (PD-24 item 2). The R16 turn, n = 1.155, stays available: the stall allows 1.528 at the loiter speed and 20,000 ft (1.444 with P2's C_L,max). The negative limit is reachable below V_C (negative corner 93.4 kt EAS at take-off weight), so the protection must hold it.

rows.title: Low-speed protection
rows.text: No commanded speed below {k} V_stall clean at the current weight (R17). With r0's C_L,max {cl0}: {to0} kt EAS at take-off weight, {zf0} kt at zero-fuel weight, {ob0} kt payload off with ballast. With P2's measured {cl1}, the r1 value: {to1}, {zf1} and {ob1} kt EAS (schedule S-6).
rows.headline: to0
rows.statement: No commanded speed below 1.3 V_stall clean at the current weight (R17). With r0's C_L,max 1.350: 69.3 kt EAS at take-off weight, 57.5 kt at zero-fuel weight, 57.2 kt payload off with ballast. With P2's measured 1.276, the r1 value: 71.3, 59.1 and 58.8 kt EAS (schedule S-6).

rows.title: Gust criterion above V_C
rows.text: Between V_C and V_D the gust is {U_C} ft/s at V_C falling linearly to {U_D} ft/s at V_D (PD-8, the ruled rule). At V_D the structure is cleared to the manoeuvre limit +{man} and to the ruled gust, worst {gup} / {gdn} payload on ({obup} payload off with ballast). It is not cleared to a {U_C} ft/s gust at V_D: {hup} / {hdn}.
rows.headline: U_D
rows.statement: Between V_C and V_D the gust is 30 ft/s at V_C falling linearly to 15 ft/s at V_D (PD-8, the ruled rule). At V_D the structure is cleared to the manoeuvre limit +3.8 and to the ruled gust, worst 2.920 / -0.920 payload on (2.935 payload off with ballast). It is not cleared to a 30 ft/s gust at V_D: 4.841 / -2.841.

rows.title: Altitude limits
rows.text: The protection holds the aircraft at or below {alt} ft, R12's ceiling requirement (PD-24 item 3; R12 asks for the service ceiling {marg} ft above it; r0's service ceiling is {ceil} ft, P0's engine-cycle value {cyc_lo} to {cyc_hi} ft). The engine's maximum operating altitude and its in-flight relight envelope are declared assumptions with no source value (R-f); the mission altitude is {mis} ft.
rows.headline: alt
rows.statement: The protection holds the aircraft at or below 23,000 ft, R12's ceiling requirement (PD-24 item 3; R12 asks for the service ceiling 500 ft above it; r0's service ceiling is 30,439 ft, P0's engine-cycle value 30,407 to 30,432 ft). The engine's maximum operating altitude and its in-flight relight envelope are declared assumptions with no source value (R-f); the mission altitude is 20,000 ft.

rows.title: Payload-off operating limit
rows.text: Payload off, the aircraft flies only with at least {bal} lb of ballast at the payload station (P4b; PD-13). At {W} lb the ruled gust at V_C and V_D stays inside: {up} / {dn}. The gust speed limit stays at V_D up to {clear} ft and falls below V_C from {below} ft ({vbelow} kt EAS), above EP-8's altitude limit. Payload off without ballast is not flown.
rows.headline: bal
rows.statement: Payload off, the aircraft flies only with at least 474 lb of ballast at the payload station (P4b; PD-13). At 2,392.6 lb the ruled gust at V_C and V_D stays inside: 3.523 / -1.523. The gust speed limit stays at V_D up to 25,000 ft and falls below V_C from 27,500 ft (109.2 kt EAS), above EP-8's altitude limit. Payload off without ballast is not flown.

acceptance.what: no row is blank: EP-1 to EP-9 each have a statement, numbers and a record
every number equals the value at its record and key
EP-3 consistent with P5: the load factor at V_C plus the allowed excursion, recomputed with P5's code
EP-7 consistent with P5: the gust load factors at V_D recomputed with P5's code
EP-5 keeps R16's turn, n = 1.155, inside the command limit and below the stall at loiter
coding check: power for level flight at r0's level top speed equals full throttle
coding check: the dive integration against its closed form with no force
coding check: V_stall at take-off weight and r0's C_L,max equals r0's recorded value

r1.not_changed: r1's drag (longer aft body, PD-21) and wing are not in these numbers; r0's polar is used.
